description: Installation geometry for the approved circular wall, retaining six open camp roads. These are geometric guides, not finished game artwork.
postOwnership: Retain the original 7.5-degree post grid where it fits. Every exposed road end owns a finished post; non-road ending posts still belong to the next sector. A road post replaces any grid post closer than 57 world units.

collisionFootprint.note: Thirty-four points fit the game collision validator. Expanded angular endpoints contain the finished 49-world-unit road posts; centreline road intervals remain separately recorded.
